landing.tagline: Know Your Rights. Take the Right Action.
landing.hero_title: Turn scattered evidence into your next clear step.
landing.hero_description: Bangladesh-first consumer resolution copilot. Organize dispute evidence, understand verified procedural paths, and draft structured consumer complaints without legal confusion.
landing.preview_sample_issue: Prepaid phone not delivered (৳5,500 total, contradictory receipts)
landing.preview_finding: Identified: Consumer Rights Protection Act 2009 s.45 (Failure to deliver promised product)
landing.preview_action: Prepared Action: Formal written seller notice with 72-hour cure period before DNCRP escalation.
landing.scenario_gallery_sub: Explore simulated dispute runs through our actual production engine.
landing.how_it_works_sub: From scattered receipts and Bengali narration to a defensible complaint package in four clear steps.
landing.step1_desc: Speak in Bangla/English, paste dispute text, or upload receipts and screenshots.
landing.step2_desc: Verify key details, transaction amounts, and dates. Full user control over every assertion.
landing.step3_desc: Explore procedural options backed by official statutory sources and regulatory remedies.
landing.step4_desc: Prepare grounded complaint packages, copy portal fields, and track follow-ups.
landing.cap1_desc: Accepts Bengali audio, mobile screenshots, printed receipts, and English/Banglish text narratives.
landing.cap2_desc: Distinguishes between user statements, machine proposals, and user-confirmed facts with bounding coordinates.
landing.cap3_desc: Deterministic AST rule evaluation against official DNCRP, Bangladesh Bank, BTRC, and IDRA regulations.
landing.cap4_desc: Simulate how correcting a date or amount changes your viable options without altering stored case history.
landing.cap5_desc: Generates structured complaint PDFs with verified Bengali typography and one-click portal field copy.
landing.cap6_desc: Record seller replies or regulatory reference numbers to trigger dependency-aware case reassessment.
landing.trust1_desc: Every statutory recommendation cites authentic gazettes and official ministry regulations.
landing.trust2_desc: We never invent legal advice, promise guaranteed refunds, or pretend to be an official government court.
landing.trust3_desc: Dispute evidence is encrypted in private quarantine; your personal data is never used to train public AI models.
landing.trust4_desc: Delete your case anytime. All files, transcripts, and parsed entities are permanently purged.
landing.tech_sub: A modern, deterministic pipeline engineered for transparency and accuracy.
landing.faq1_q: Is ClaimCraft BD an official government agency?
landing.faq1_a: No. ClaimCraft BD is an independent consumer resolution copilot. We help consumers understand their rights, organize documentation, and prepare official filings, but we do not issue rulings or make automatic submissions.
landing.faq2_q: What languages and input formats are supported?
landing.faq2_a: We support English, Standard Bangla, and Banglish text, Bengali spoken voice, and image/PDF uploads including bKash/Nagad receipts, paper memos, and F-commerce chat screenshots.
landing.faq3_q: Is my personal evidence kept private?
landing.faq3_a: Yes. Evidence is quarantined in private storage scoped strictly to your session. We use paid, zero-training enterprise AI adapters and provide instant one-click data deletion.
landing.final_cta_sub: Start in seconds. No credit card required. Full user privacy guaranteed.

intake.title: Tell Us What Happened
intake.subtitle: Speak or type in Bangla, English, or Banglish. No strict legal terms required.
intake.story_placeholder: Example: I ordered a phone for ৳5,500 from a Facebook page. I paid via bKash on 15 October, but the seller blocked me and never delivered the item...
intake.attachments_hint: Upload bKash/Nagad receipts, bank memos, Facebook Messenger screenshots, or photos.
intake.voice_hint: Click the microphone to speak in Bengali. You can edit the transcript after speaking.
intake.privacy_notice: Your evidence is encrypted in private storage and never used to train public AI models.

actions.unsubmitted_notice: Status: Prepared, Not Submitted. EbarKi does not file on your behalf. You control external submission.

actions.portal_companion_desc: Per-field copy data for verified government portals. No credentials or CAPTCHA automation (T33).

actions.export_desc: Export dispute materials with cryptographic provenance hash (T34). Export never marks case as filed (T27).
actions.destinations_desc: Direct links, verified procedures, and link-health fallback channels (T54).

activity.title: Case Activity & Living Timeline
activity.subtitle: Track versioned changes, seller replies, and regulatory milestones.

activity.stale_tab_error: This case has been updated in another window. Please refresh to load the latest version (T41).
